# Proposed labels

A proposal for the maintainer to apply. The issue forms use `bug` and `feature`.

| Name | Colour | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `d73a4a` | Something does not work as specified |
| `feature` | `0e8a16` | New capability |
| `qol` | `a2eeef` | Small quality-of-life improvement |
| `ux-polish` | `f9d0c4` | Visual or interaction refinement, no new capability |
| `internals` | `5319e7` | Refactor, build, tooling; no user-visible change |
| `test-rig` | `fbca04` | Tests, fake phone, emulator, VM harness |
| `release` | `1d76db` | Versioning, packaging, release notes |
| `android` | `3ddc84` | Phone app |
| `mac` | `bfd4f2` | Mac app and extensions |
| `protocol` | `c5def5` | Wire protocol, `docs/PROTOCOL.md` |
| `tools` | `e4e669` | Scripts and tools under `tools/` and `scripts/` |
| `docs` | `0075ca` | Documentation only |
| `good first issue` | `7057ff` | Small, well specified, safe for a newcomer |
| `help wanted` | `008672` | The maintainer would welcome a contribution |
| `needs-repro` | `cfd3d7` | Cannot be acted on until reproduced or more detail is given |
